maya: Quick follow-up from postmortem: vendor auth started throttling token exchanges during regional surge; caused ~10-15% model-registry errors. Need owners for mitigations.

sahil: Oof. Short-term fixes?

ellie: Quick list: 1) local short TTL token cache + fallback; 2) client-side soft rate limiter; 3) synthetic probe + dashboard.

kyle: I'll take SDK change (cache + exp-backoff+jitter). PR by 2025-03-04, canary to Dedicated after review.

james: I'll reach out to vendor for burst limits + sandbox. Target reply by 2025-03-03.

ellie: I'll own runbook + probe + alerts. ETA 2025-03-06. Alert: >5% token-exchange errors over 3m.

maya: Consolidating actions:
- D1 sdk-backoff-cache -> kyle -> 2025-03-04
- D2 vendor-limits-sandbox -> james -> 2025-03-03
- D3 runbook+probe+alert -> ellie -> 2025-03-06
- D4 canary-rollout-plan -> kyle -> 2025-03-07

sahil: For alerts, please add token-exchange latency p95 and delta-based spike detection. Those predicted failures.

ellie: will do. Also adding extraction of X-RateLimit headers into traces.

maya: Ops-bot: schedule retro?

ops-bot: Retro scheduled Thu 2025-03-09 09:30am PT in #incidents.

maya: Please open issues and link them to the postmortem doc tonight. We'll treat this as P0 until D1-D3 are complete. :thumbsup:

(END)
